gloss: interest rate hike; raising interest rates

definitions.gloss: interest rate hike, raising interest rates
definitions.explanation: An increase in interest rates, typically by a central bank as a monetary policy tool. Frequently appears in economic news and financial discussions.

examples.japanese: {日銀|にちぎん}が{利上|りあ}げを{決定|けってい}した。
examples.english: The Bank of Japan decided to raise interest rates.

examples.japanese: {利上|りあ}げの{影響|えいきょう}で{住宅|じゅうたく}ローンの{金利|きんり}が{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: Mortgage interest rates went up due to the rate hike.

examples.japanese: {追加|ついか}{利上|りあ}げの{可能性|かのうせい}について{市場|しじょう}が{注目|ちゅうもく}している。
examples.english: The market is watching closely for the possibility of further rate hikes.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{利上|りあ}げを{決定|けってい}する (decide to raise rates)
・{追加|ついか}{利上|りあ}げ (additional rate hike)
・{利上|りあ}げ{幅|はば} (size of the rate increase)
・{利上|りあ}げ{観測|かんそく} (rate hike expectations)

USAGE NOTES:
The opposite is {利下|りさ}げ (interest rate cut). In Japanese economic news, {利上|りあ}げ most commonly refers to actions by the {日本銀行|にほんぎんこう} (Bank of Japan) or foreign central banks like the FRB (Federal Reserve). The word is an abbreviation of {金利引|きんりひ}き{上|あ}げ.
